snippet.title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional, a Survivors-like action arcade roguelike game developed by Shaun Hammond Business Solutions Limited. Players will take to the offensive against a host of different viruses and adware enemies with nostalgic elements of the early 2000s. Make use of Y2K weaponry to clear the desktop in Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional, coming soon to PC (Steam).
